title: I Followed the Concert Merch Wristband Into the Staff-Only Tent

parts.text: I bought the merch preorder that promised a staff-line wristband at 6:05 p.m. The tent scanned me, then a volunteer pulled me back because a radio said hold merch for radio guests. I was twenty-four, general admission, holding a receipt with WRISTBAND INCLUDED. Radio guests were a DJ's cousins in street clothes. I photographed the receipt, the band on my arm, and the tent sign STAFF / PREORDER. Then I walked the long way around and scanned again at the side printer. At 6:11 the same volunteer tried to cut the band off me while the cousins took hoodies without SKUs.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: They are cutting at my wrist while hoodies leave without SKUs.

social.video_title: Preorder wristband versus cousins in the staff tent — Part 1/2
social.description: Receipt said included. Radio guests were cousins. The scissors came out. Would you have scanned the side printer?

parts.text: I asked for a manager and the scanner log. The log liked my SKU. The cousins' pile went back on the table. I got the hoodie I paid for in March. The volunteer kept the scissors for actual plastic waste. Radio guests still exist; they now need a radio. Preorder is a contract with cotton. I wore the hoodie for the encore. The side printer jammed on someone else. Not my SKU.

social.video_title: The scanner log liked my March SKU — Part 2/2
social.description: Hoodie back, cousins unpiled, encore cotton. Was a radio a cousin?
